# Indoor character artwork

| In-game view | User-supplied SVG | Local source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Down / front | Pixel Trainer Girl Walking Cycle.svg | walk-girl.svg |
| Right | Pixel Trainer Walk Cycle.svg | walk-cycle.svg |
| Left | Pixel Girl Walking Sprite Sheet.svg | walk-sheet.svg |
| Up / back | Four-Frame Pixel Backpacker Walk Cycle.svg | walk-back.svg |
| Front idle | Chibi Pixel Trainer Sprite.svg | idle.svg |

`frames/` contains four native SVG walking frames per direction and an idle pose, cropped and aligned from the supplied sheets. Detached tracing specks were omitted; the original artwork and transparent backgrounds are preserved.

These clothes are used in the spaceship and the wake-up scene. The existing astronaut suit is used on the Martian surface. Entering, leaving, or reloading a location selects the matching artwork automatically.

The source files in Downloads were left unchanged. No new character artwork was generated.
